stages.effectText: The first summoned unit does not consume deployment slots (The last summoned unit on the field does not return a deployment slot when retreated or defeated)
Drones gain Invisibility for 23 seconds after deployment (cannot be targeted by enemy ranged attacks). If Magallan is adjacent to the drone, she gains the same effect
Drones gain Invisibility for 26 seconds after deployment (cannot be targeted by enemy ranged attacks). If Magallan is adjacent to the drone, she gains the same effect
Can hold +3 additional summoned units and summoned unit deployment costs are reduced [ note 1 ]
Can use up to 5 drones that do not block (max 4 deployed at once). Drones' effect changes based upon Skill.
Can use up to 5 stronger [ note 2 ] drones that do not block (max 4 deployed at once). Drones' effect changes based upon Skill.
